title: Vietnam & Cambodia Delights with FREE Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels
highlights: Enjoy the best of Vietnam and Cambodia on this amazing vacation, from exploring an underground network at Cu Chi Tunnels to the largest religious monument in the world - Angkor Wat.
Admire the elegant French design, characterised by red bricks and twin bell towers, as you visit Notre Dame Cathedral in Ho Chi Minh City.
Gain interesting insights into Vietnam's history as you explore the legendary Cu Chi Tunnel, a significant site from the Vietnam War.
Take a soothing boat ride in Tonle Sap Lake, Cambodia, popular for being the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
Immerse yourself in the grandeur and rich history of Angkor Tham, a UNESCO World Heritage site that comprises hundreds of temples.
overview:
About the Tour:
On this tour of Vietnam and Cambodia, experience a captivating blend of history, culture, and nature. Begin with the ancient wonders of Cambodia, where you’ll visit the iconic Angkor Wat and other UNESCO World Heritage temples. Cruise on Tonle Sap Lake and take in the scenic countryside. In Vietnam, explore bustling cities like Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh, sail through the stunning limestone islands of Halong Bay, and experience the vibrant culture of floating markets on the Mekong Delta. This journey promises adventure, culture, and memorable landscapes.

know_before_you_go: Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, you’ll get transferred to the hotel for check in. Later, head out to explore the city at your own leisure. Start with a visit to the Saigon River, where you can enjoy the scenic views. Visit the peaceful Mariamman Hindu Temple, dedicated to the goddess Mariamman, who is known for her power to cure diseases and bring luck and wealth. After exploring the city, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Standard Hotel
items.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board the transfer from the hotel to explore Ho Chi Minh City on a sightseeing tour. Visit the historic Reunification Palace, which served as the residence and office of South Vietnamese President Nguyen Van Thieu. Admire the detailing in the architecture of Saigon Central Post Office and learn about the country's past at the War Remnants Museum through exhibits of the First Indochina War and the Vietnam War. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: In the morning, get transferred from the hotel and enjoy a visit to the Cu Chi Tunnels. Explore this underground network spreading over 200 km, which was used during the Vietnam War. The tunnels are famous for featuring trap doors, living areas, storage, weapons factories, hospitals, command centres, and kitchens. While you are there, also watch a video on their construction and remnants of the fierce battles from the 1960s. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Ho Chi Minh City
days.desc: Take the day to explore the city on your own. You can start your day by visiting the Jade Emperor Pagoda, dedicated to the Jade Emperor, the supreme deity in Taoist belief.  Also, explore the stunning Vietnam History Museum, which is dedicated to Asian and Vietnamese history. You can spend some time in peace at the beautiful Thien Hau Temple, an ancient temple dedicated to the Chinese goddess, Mazu. Afterwards, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival at the Siem Reap International Airport, you’ll be driven to the hotel for check in. Later, you can explore some of the famous places in the city on your own, like the War Museum Cambodia, the Preah Khan, and the Angkor Silk Farm, among others. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at HARI Residence & Spa - Siem Reap

days.title: Visit to Tonle Sap Lake
days.desc: Have an amazing experience as you get driven to visit the Tonle Sap Lake, one of the most beautiful lakes in Vietnam. Board a traditional wooden boat to visit Chong Kneas Floating Village, located south of Siem Reap. Gain insight into the local Khmer lifestyle, which revolves around fishing and tourism. After completing your tour of this stunning lake, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Angkor Wat
days.desc: MMake the most of your time today as you board the pre-booked transfer to Angkor Thom for a sightseeing tour. Start at Bayon Temple, known for its stone faces. Explore the Royal Enclosure and the terraces of the Elephant and Leper King. Continue to Ta Prohm, famous for trees growing out of its ruins. Finally, marvel at Angkor Wat’s five towers and gallery walls adorned with intricate carvings of tales from the Ramayana and Mahabharata. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
